The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8e4c129bdb0f2f45), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Under the hypotheses of this section, fix arbitrary nonnegative integers m∗, D∗. For every sufficiently large integer n there is a smooth real Un satisfying (3.19) and (3.20), with B = 110, and Fn(Un) ≥ cwaven Z Ω L(x) dx, (3.26) where cwave > 0 depends only on the fixed coordinates and metric neighborhood. Moreover, Un = wn and g = g∗ on {r ≥ t2}. (3.27) The thresholds and constants in the differential estimates may depend on the fixed profile and accuracy orders; B and cwave do not. The sign functional is finite, fixed, and has all the persistence and area-comparison properties of Proposition 3.3.
